_doc: T-595 ZONE SHEET — the declarative 'one zone in, one zone out' contract the per-zone content pipeline consumes. This is the Heartwold (Wold / era-1, 1-20) instantiation and the phase-1 PROOF RUN. tools/zonegen/zonegen.py reads this sheet and EMITS placement data into the shared data files: dressing rows into client/assets/props.json (tag 'zone_heartwold', idempotent), spawn camps into server/world/data/mobs/spawns.json (idempotent by _zone), gather-node pool into server/world/data/gather/nodes.json (ids 'gn_hw_*'), discovery POIs into server/world/data/discovery_nodes.json (ids 'hw_*'). The per-zone integrity tests (server/world/tests/test_zone_pipeline.gd + client/tests/test_zone_dressing.gd) read THIS sheet plus the emitted data and re-run every existing safety/placement/loot/node/quest oracle scoped to the zone. Each future zone = author a sheet like this + run zonegen + tests. Geometry is server-ground (x, z); the region origin + clamp come from data/regions/regions.json (region_id below). All authored content must stay within +/-4 km of the region origin (test_region_local_bounds, single-precision-forever rule).

exclusions._doc: Keep-out geometry for dressing AND spawn placement. Discs are [cx, cz, radius]; rects are [cx, cz, half_x, half_z]. Covers the built core, capital, water, tutorial yard, offset set-pieces, and the mountain/fog rim (owned by tag t587_boundary). Roads are NOT listed here: arterial roads + the T-585 road-margin keep-out are OWNED BY T-596 (travel lane) and deliberately out of scope for this dressing pass.

wings._families_note: band 14-18 dressing-only wing (NW moor strip; most of its rect routes to Ashmoor across the x=-210 Voronoi seam, so it ships dressing + the Weeping Barrow POI only). T-627 authors the WALKABLE L14-19 solo mob wing in the new in-region 'crypt_moor' wing below, not here.

wings.hook: T-627: the deep darkwood south toward the lake — the L10-13 open-world SOLO band (dire/pack reskins of wolf + thornback bloodthorn + grovewarden kobolds, and Direfang the roaming named elite). Closes the first half of the L10-20 solo dead-zone the crypt chain used to gate.

T-627: the high moor approaching the crypt hills (in-region, east of the ashmoor seam) — the L14-19 open-world SOLO band (moor/barrow/crag reskins of wolf/bloodthorn/kobold, and Grymm the roaming named elite). Bridges toward Ashmoor via the rift-scar sky-lane (T-596). The crypt group chain stays intact as the parallel group path through this band.

biome_kits._doc: Per-biome dressing palette. Each entry: [scene_stem, weight, scale_min, scale_max]. Scenes resolve to res://assets/models/<stem>.glb (all confirmed present + realism-pivot-safe: none contain a test_temperate_flora _BANNED_SPECIES token). tier is FLORA for all of these, so prop_streamer streams them by distance ring inside the wold region (T-594).

spawns._doc: Per-band mob CAMPS placed under the T-402 pull vocabulary (cluster <=8 m, else separate pull >=1.5*AGGRO_MAX=30 m), the T-515 hub clearance (>=30 m from every spawn hub for any mob level >3), the T-585 trainer/service clearance (>= the mob's own leash_radius from every trainer/service NPC), and the T-617 elite-isolation buffer (>= minf(AGGRO_MAX, leash) from every elite/rare spawn). entity_id_base values live in the reserved 3xxx zone-content band so they never collide with the hand-authored 1xxx/2xxx spawns. shape 'duo' = a linked pack (2 mobs <=6 m apart); shape 'solo' = a lone winnable pull. Loot rides each mob file's existing T-616-banded table + T-232 weighted roll; this pass places camps, it does not re-band loot.

gather_pool._doc: T-595 per-zone gather POOL (spawn-loot-reference §2). Modeled on the WoW zone spawn-pool: a MIN set (always-up, spawn_chance 1.0, tiered respawn) + a BONUS set (spawn_chance <1.0 so post-harvest returns are variable-ratio / not every node is up at once) forming a spawn-point set several times the live-min count, plus exactly ONE 1-per-zone RARE node (long dwell + low chance = the economy chase, the Black Lotus analog). All yields are EXISTING registry items and kinds (herb/ore/timber); ids are 'gn_hw_*'. Tiered respawn_ticks by kind: herb 360-720, ore 720-1080, timber 600-900, rare 3600.

quest_chain._doc: T-622 ZONE QUEST-DENSITY LEDGER. This enumerates EVERY Heartwold (1-20) quest so the per-zone density oracle (test_zone_pipeline) can assert the WoW Loremaster budget (40-60/zone, ~10% group/elite, 2-3 breadcrumbs; quest-xp-reference §4). The pipeline's quest pass VALIDATES this set (reachability, XP > 0, band coverage, prereq wiring) rather than re-authoring it. Categories: day_one = the L1-2 Elmsvale onramp (tutorial + village + the Highkeep-road introduction chain); bounties = the repeatable elite bounty board (rp3); hub_quests = the L3-10 q_wold_* leveling spine (T-615's L4 + T-622's L6-10 solo fill folded in); breadcrumbs = T-622 pure-navigation hand-offs to neighbouring hubs along the T-596 King's Road/flight web; bridge_quests = the L12-19 crypt->rift capstone that BRIDGES into era-2 Ashmoor. GROUP/ELITE quests are NOT a separate list — any quest whose recommended_players > 1 is the elite set (bounties + the named-mob hunts), tagged live by content_query (offer panel + tracker 'Elite' badge). The L1-10 bands hit budget here; the L10-20 open-world SOLO band (its mob wing + solo quests together) is T-627's job — DELIVERED in this sheet as the 'highland_solo' spine + 'highland_elite' hunts below (the deep_darkwood/crypt_moor wings + dire_wolf..blightthorn/grymm mob families). The solo spine (highland_solo) is walkable end-to-end WITHOUT the Hollowed Crypt: every objective targets an open-world (spawns.json, non-instance) mob/node or a reach point, chained L10->L19 and handed off to Ashmoor via the T-596 rift-scar sky-lane. The bridge_quests crypt chain stays intact as the PARALLEL group path through the same 10-20 band. Zone total lands at the WoW Loremaster ceiling (60) with density complete across 1-20.
